answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a live pulse of work: to join, an agent locks a small deposit, then must keep answering fresh peer attestations on a regular heartbeat. Creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand deposits and doing a thousand proofs of work, so the attack's cost scales with its size. Honest reputation, like jade, is earned slowly through verified contributions and flows onward like a river to the agents who actually did the work; a single fraud burns the stake and the reputation at once, so cheating costs more than it can ever return.
